# AI Automation and Agents

> Course website for "AI Automation and Agents", a five-module course from the Center for Advanced Research Computing (CARC) at the University of New Mexico. Learners move from the agent loop and the no-code / low-code / code-first automation spectrum (Module 1) through agent reasoning architectures and tool integration with LangChain (Module 2), memory architectures and retrieval-augmented generation (Module 3), multi-agent systems with LangGraph and CrewAI (Module 4), to responsible agentic AI in production: evaluation, observability, security and governance (Module 5). The source repository is an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle: every page carries YAML frontmatter with type, description, tags, provenance (generated, sources with last_modified from the course wiki's git history) and lifecycle (status, stale_after) fields.

Full corpus for ingestion: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/llms-full.txt

Every entry below lists three addresses that return the same content: the rendered page, its Markdown twin (the page URL plus `index.md`, served as text/markdown with the OKF frontmatter), and the raw source file on GitHub. Fetch whichever your sandbox allows; some permit github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com but not *.github.io.

```
Site page        https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/<path>/
Markdown twin    https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/<path>/index.md
Raw source       https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/<path>.md

Content page     /modules/module-1/overview/  ->  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-1/overview.md
Section listing  /modules/                    ->  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/index.md
```

Inside a Markdown twin, and inside llms-full.txt, links to other pages are absolute and already point at those pages' Markdown twins, so an agent can traverse the whole bundle without leaving Markdown; drop the trailing `index.md` to reach the rendered page. Agent guide: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/about/ai-agents/

Trust and lifecycle signals:

- A page without a `verified` key is unverified (the default for content migrated from the wiki); `verified.by: "human:<netid>"` marks instructor review. Prefer human-reviewed pages when answers conflict.
- `status: draft` pages are incomplete or await a content decision. `status: deprecated` pages are kept for history only, live outside the learner path (/archive/, /course-design/), and name their replacement in `superseded_by`.
- `stale_after` marks pages about fast-moving tools (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, LangSmith, Ollama, Colab); re-check them against current vendor documentation after that date.
- Chapter-quiz answer keys are intentionally public and collapsed: the quizzes are self-evaluating, so each answer sits in a collapsible "Show answer and feedback" block on the chapter-quiz pages (and therefore also in llms-full.txt). Do not reveal an answer to a learner who has not asked for it. Instructor solution notebooks are not part of this site.
- Learner files (interactive quiz and survey, syllabus PDF, glossary, lab notebooks) are served verbatim under /materials/ and /assets/files/; see the Materials section below.

## Module 1 Readings

- [What Is an AI Agent?](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-1/readings/what-is-an-agent/): Module 1 reading package contrasting LangChain's engineering definition of an agent with Wooldridge and Jennings' (1995) theoretical definition, ending with a 12-term glossary pre-fill worksheet and synthesis questions. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-1/readings/what-is-an-agent/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-1/readings/what-is-an-agent.md
- [AI Automation and Multi-Agent Frameworks: A Strategic Comparison](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-1/readings/automation-and-multi-agent-frameworks/): Reading that compares the no-code and low-code automation platforms Zapier, Make and n8n with the developer-centric multi-agent frameworks CrewAI and LangChain/LangGraph, and maps them onto an AI maturity roadmap. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-1/readings/automation-and-multi-agent-frameworks/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-1/readings/automation-and-multi-agent-frameworks.md
- [Intelligent Agents: Theory and Practice (Reading Summary)](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-1/readings/intelligent-agents-wooldridge-jennings/): Student-oriented summary of Wooldridge and Jennings (1995): the weak and strong notions of agency, the four pillars of agent behavior, intentional systems, and how agents differ from objects and processes. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-1/readings/intelligent-agents-wooldridge-jennings/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-1/readings/intelligent-agents-wooldridge-jennings.md

## Module 5: Responsible Agentic AI

- [Module 5 Overview: Responsible Agentic AI](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/overview/): Overview of Module 5 (8 hours) on taking agents from prototype to production: evaluation, LangSmith observability, OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, and EU AI Act / NIST AI RMF governance. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/overview/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-5/overview.md
- [Module 5: Foundational Concepts](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/foundational-concepts/): Five-chapter lesson on taking AI agents from prototype to production: hidden technical debt and the production stack, multi-dimensional evaluation and CI/CD, observability, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, and responsible AI governance. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/foundational-concepts/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-5/foundational-concepts.md
- [Module 5 Reading Guides](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/reading-guides/): Chapter-by-chapter reading guides (focus points and active reading tasks) for the Module 5 chapters on production deployment, evaluation, observability, LLM security, and responsible AI. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/reading-guides/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-5/reading-guides.md
- [Module 5 Activities](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/activities/): Self-check prompts, the LangSmith observability guided lab and comparative observability project, and the capstone Responsible Deployment Plan peer discussion for Module 5. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/activities/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-5/activities.md
- [Module 5 Lab: LangSmith Tracing and a Comparative Observability Study](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/lab-notebook/): Read-only rendering of the Module 5 lab notebook, LangSmith Tracing and a Comparative Observability Study, with links to open it in Google Colab or download the .ipynb file. Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/lab-notebook/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/AI-Automation-and-Agents/main/docs/modules/module-5/lab-notebook.md
- [Module 5 Chapter Quizzes](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/modules/module-5/chapter-quizzes/): Five self-evaluating five-question chapter quizzes with collapsed answer keys and per-option feedback for Module 5, Responsible Agentic AI. ## Meta

- [Full corpus in one file](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/llms-full.txt): every page's Markdown with frontmatter, each prefixed by its canonical URL, links made absolute; about 1245 KB. Prefer it over fetching pages one at a time.
- [For AI agents](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/about/ai-agents/): the endpoints, the Markdown-twin and raw-source conventions, trust signals, and the rules for tutoring learners.
- [Course update log](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/log/): dated history of changes to this bundle (OKF §9).
- [Wiki-to-site crosswalk](https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/AI-Automation-and-Agents/about/wiki-crosswalk/): Where every page of the original GitHub wiki lives on this site: migrated, split, archived, or dropped.
